preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between n-1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of clones k is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices, each with an index between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of routes is equal to the number of clones k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(route) <= 6 for route in routes)
postconditions.description: Each route visits at most 6 vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= vertex <= n for vertex in route) for route in routes)
postconditions.description: Each vertex in every route has an index between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(route[0] == start_vertex for route, start_vertex in zip(routes, start_vertices))
postconditions.description: Each route starts at the corresponding starting vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(vertex in set.union(*routes) for vertex in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Every vertex in the graph is visited by at least one clone.
